Author: Jacob5800
Name: Portrait Atelier
Description: Create and apply curated portrait designs from your own character in one click.
Punchline: Make and apply a portrait in one click.
Changelog:
### 0.1.3.0
- Added one-click portrait styling with curated looks and generated variations.
- Added options to use unlocked poses and expressions and owned backgrounds, frames, and decorations, while keeping the current character or banner design when desired.
- Improved validation and application of changes in the in-game editor.

Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Punchline: Automatically price new and existing retainer listings.
Description: Automatically price eligible inventory and reprice existing listings one gil below matching competition using Universalis market prices and recent sale history.
Changelog:
### 0.4.17.0
- Added a Retrieved price subtab in Price lookup.
- Showed the retrieved price for Search and Captured items, including inventory and retainer-list Retrieve buttons.

### 0.4.16.0
- Added saved retainer listing snapshots and a deduplicated queue of changed item IDs.
- Added a marketboard lookup that waits for an open marketboard, searches queued items, and opens each item's listings.

### 0.4.15.0
- Reverted automatic Compare Prices views after listings and repricing.
- Made the retrieved market price easier to spot in a dedicated Price Lookup result row.
